title: Dual Mechanisms of Value Expression: Intrinsic vs. Prompted Values in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper systematically evaluates and benchmarks how Large Language Models express and represent human values based on Schwartz's theory, which includes moral and ethical dimensions such as Benevolence, Universalism, and Tradition. It utilizes situational dilemmas to test value-based trade-offs and specifically identifies neural components within the model that respond to religious and spiritual concepts.
